name: Hidden Haven Blueberries
description: Hidden Haven Blueberries is a family-run farm in 460 Goldsmith Rd, FL. It grows Strawberries, Blueberries, Apples, Corn, and Honey, with seasonal availability through spring and summer. The harvest is typically at its peak in spring. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Mar – Jun in this growing zone.
